observations: A face fills nearly the entire frame against a flat yellow-green ground, with loose dark lines defining hair that bleeds off all four edges.
Two pale eyes with blue-tinted irises sit under heavy black lash marks; cyan and orange scribble lines cross the forehead and cheeks in overlapping loops.
The mouth is open, showing a row of white teeth framed by deep red lips, with the lower face built from layered dark brown, olive, and pink shapes.
reading: Yellow-green pushes the face forward with unusual force, while the dark hair dissolves into the same ground at the edges, collapsing any sense of distance. The eyes hold still against that pressure—pale, wide, ringed by dense lash lines—while cyan and orange loops scatter across the skin without settling into shadow or highlight. The open mouth reads as raw sound rather than speech. The face neither retreats nor performs; it simply arrives.
contextAngle: Within the owned nifty-faces subset, this work shares its title neighbor nnxyz nifty faces #86's open-mouth tension and layered scribble marks, but trades that work's purple ground for a yellow-green field that pulls the face closer to the picture surface.

connections.reason: Both works show an open-mouthed face built from overlapping colored scribble lines over a solid ground, but #86 uses a cool purple field while #87 uses yellow-green, shifting the overall pressure of the image.
nnotb #134 shares the close-cropped face-filling composition and loose looping lines over dark skin tones, but its black ground absorbs the figure where #87's yellow-green pushes it outward.
